outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/diagram illustrating illumination overhead percentages for different camera exposure times based on a single calculated value per condition, not an average of replicate measurements presented as a data plot. No individual data points are applicable.

Panel B is a line plot (photobleaching decay curves over frame number) with shaded s.e.m. bands. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel C is a scatter plot (ΔROS vs exposure time) with a fitted curve; scatter plots inherently show individual data points (one per condition/color) and are exempt.

Panel D shows individual cell migration tracks (line plots), each line representing a single migrating cell's path, so individual data are already displayed; line plots are exempt from requiring additional point overlays.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean migration speed with error bars, and individual cell data points (dots) are overlaid on each bar, satisfying the requirement.
Panel F consists of micrographs (Mitotracker, Paxillin, Merge images), not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel G is a time-series of micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H is a time-series of micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel I is a line plot (normalized cell area over time) with error bars; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel J is a line plot (normalized mitochondrial area over time) with error bars; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
